purpose: Add a bounded first real supplier/sourcing evidence layer after the P2B readiness audit. Official supplier capabilities may be canonicalized as source/supplier records; product and price claims remain source-stated evidence and should be staged unless an exact canonical variant/component match is deterministic.
semantic_boundary: All supplier capabilities and prices below are source-stated public web evidence observed on 2026-08-30.
No gemstone authenticity, grade, treatment, ethical sourcing or geological provenance is independently verified by GPT.
Retail/catalog prices are not treated as landed production cost and VAT treatment is preserved in notes.
Marketplace supplier listings are discovery evidence only and remain unverified until direct supplier/product verification.
Do not infer missing MOQ, shipping, certification, stock, trade discount or material quality.

supplier_candidates.name: Gemstone Wholesale / edelsteine.de

supplier_candidates.name: Perles & Co

Official site states more than 60,000 bead/component references and says products comply with applicable EU REACH requirements; it also describes independent-lab testing and XRF/Gemtester quality controls.
Official catalog exposes quantity-tier prices for many jewellery findings.

supplier_candidates.name: Laval Europe
capability_claims: Official site describes Laval as a major European jewellery/watchmaking wholesale supplier.
Official sterling-silver findings catalog includes clasps, chains, spacer beads and other 925 findings.
Official site states no minimum order and delivery to most European countries in 3-5 working days; German packaging page states 3-5 working days to Germany and Austria.
Official packaging catalog lists hundreds of jewellery boxes and offers in-house logo/address personalization.

supplier_candidates.name: Intercollection
capability_claims: Official site describes a B2B wholesale jewellery business operating for over thirty years in France and the UK.
Official site states its production has Responsible Jewellery Council certification and that jewellery is tested for EU GPSR and other market standards.
Catalog focus is finished/wholesale jewellery and beads/charms rather than only loose findings, so fit for custom component sourcing remains to be verified.

gpt_phase_assessment.assessment_text: The P2B audit shows that image/design evidence is mature but sourcing data is not: 62 material variants contain only one indicative price, only one supplier/offer exists and it is an unverified sample, and all nine packaging options lack supplier offers. The next efficient step is a bounded supplier-discovery and price-evidence intake, not broader schema work or product/BOM expansion.
execution_implications: Create/reconcile real supplier/source identities from official supplier pages.
Stage exact public catalog offer claims with provenance instead of forcing uncertain material/component matches into canonical supplier_offer.
Run a deterministic matchability audit against existing material variants/components/packaging options.
Promote only exact matches supported by existing canonical identity; leave all uncertain offers staged/review_required.
Do not contact suppliers, place orders or select a production supplier in this phase.
